en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy European square with a domed church or mosque-like building with a bell tower on the left and an ornate multi‑story historicist building with shops on the right. Horse‑drawn carriages, a tram, and pedestrians fill the street. At the top left the printed caption reads "PÉCS" and below it "Széchenyi-tér". The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, a green Hungarian stamp and printed publisher information along the left edge.
